result.summary: This PR makes `createwalletdescriptor` automatically use the single `unused(KEY)` HD key created by `addhdkey` when no active descriptors exist, avoiding a manual `gethdkeys`/copy-paste step. It also adds a duplicate-key check to `addhdkey` (rejecting an xprv already known to the wallet), and updates the multisig tutorial to start participant wallets blank with only a legacy descriptor to reduce accidental singlesig address exposure, plus a release note.
result.problem: Users following the new blank-wallet workflow (createwallet blank=true, addhdkey, createwalletdescriptor) previously hit a hard failure requiring manual xpub lookup; separately, addhdkey allowed silently adding a key the wallet already had. Both are minor UX/correctness gaps in a workflow enabled by recently merged PRs #29130/#29136/#32784.

resolved_concerns: rkrux questioned reusing GetScriptlessSPKMs vs simpler checks; author called it orthogonal to this PR, discussion did not escalate.
adyshimony found a bug (duplicate xprv via active descriptor not caught) and a test/descriptor_tests.cpp typo (parse_pub vs parse_priv); both fixed by author in later commits.

jeanpablojp asked why createwalletdescriptor doesn't also fall back to unused(KEY) when there are multiple active descriptors; author explained the fail-safe rationale (descriptors can't be deleted) and updated help text; no pushback.
jeanpablojp suggested reusing GetHDPubKeys(HDKeyFilter::UnusedKey) instead of a separate helper; author adopted the suggestion and dropped the redundant commit.

result.card: This PR makes `createwalletdescriptor` auto-detect the single `unused(KEY)` HD key added via `addhdkey` on a blank wallet, removing a manual xpub copy-paste step in a workflow enabled by recently merged #29130/#29136/#32784. It also fixes a bug where `addhdkey` could silently add a duplicate xprv already known to the wallet (found and confirmed by reviewer adyshimony), and updates the multisig tutorial to start from blank wallets with only a legacy descriptor to avoid accidental singlesig address exposure. Review has been active and substantive: three reviewers (w0xlt, jeanpablojp, adyshimony) gave concept/approach ACKs, and every concern raised (a bug, a test typo, an ambiguous-key design question, a redundant helper) was resolved by the author in later pushes. The PR depends on and was rebased after several other merged PRs (#29136, #32784, #35436), and is currently Ready with nothing pending.
